I had it in a DVD box set but I leant it to someone last year and have just realised they never gave it back. That information was mostly to fulfil the word count. On [amazon.co.uk](https://amazon.co.uk) there still seems to be the DVD collection called Disruption and Road is still listed on the cover. I'm afraid it's £74. It's from a seller called thelastplace. I'll try pasting the link but I'm not sure if it will work wherever you are.

Isn't this is here on youtube? https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VWI3-d1tezU

Now I'm just going to talk for a bit so that I meet the minimum word count for comments. I haven't seen *Road* but I am a fan of his films so I really should get to it. *Elephant* and *Scum* are excellent and I also liked *Penda's Fen*. Anyway this youtube copy doesn't look like great quality, but not terrible either.

Yeh I bought the one that had 12 disks instead of 13 , and the extra disk had a lot of the  good stuff on it. 
Hopefully I reminded you to chase up your friend and get your dvd back!! thanks a lot for the reply
